datasets.title: China national air quality monitoring, hourly station and city archive
datasets.description: Original station and city CSV archives and successive station lists. The reader supports hourly O₃ and PM₂.₅ concentrations in µg/m³.
datasets.coverage: The station archive covers 2,040 dates across part of 2014, all of 2017, 2020 and 2023–2024, and 2025 through December 20. The city archive covers 1,827 days across all of 2017, 2020 and 2023–2025.
datasets.reference_state: From 1 September 2018 (Beijing time), GB 3095–2012 uses 298.15 K and 101.325 kPa for gaseous pollutants and the temperature and pressure during monitoring for particles. Before that date, the standard used 273 K and 101.325 kPa for all pollutants.

datasets.title: Beijing hourly air quality station archive
datasets.description: Original hourly station CSV files and annual ZIP archives. PM₂.₅ is from beijing_all and O₃ is from beijing_extra.
datasets.coverage: PM₂.₅ starts in December 2013 and O₃ in April 2014. Both end October 11, 2025. Some years and days are missing.

datasets.title: Xu et al. (2023) global station daily mean PM₂.₅
datasets.description: Daily mean PM₂.₅ concentrations compiled from multiple monitoring networks and quality-controlled by the authors. The reader extracts records for the China region.
datasets.coverage: 1,722 stations in the China region from November 27, 2013 to December 31, 2019.

datasets.title: Xu et al. (2023) global station daily maximum 8-hour average ozone
datasets.description: Daily maximum 8-hour average ozone concentrations compiled from multiple monitoring networks and quality-controlled by the authors. The reader extracts records for the China region.
datasets.coverage: 1,720 stations in the China region from May 13, 2014 to December 31, 2019.

datasets.title: NOAA ISD-Lite surface weather observations for China
datasets.publisher: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information (NCEI)
datasets.description: Annual station ZIP files, their extracted contents, a station history table and documentation. Sampling intervals include hourly and three-hourly records.
datasets.coverage: China, including Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan. Annual archives for 2014, 2017, 2020 and 2023.

datasets.title: Atmospheric nitrogen deposition observations and reference data
datasets.publisher: EANET, CAPMoN, NADP/NTN, INDAAF, EMEP and other networks and study authors
datasets.description: Raw data, monthly wet deposition measurements, historical intermediate tables, literature and training workbooks.
datasets.coverage: Dates vary by network. The merged workbook reports monthly NH₄⁺ and NO₃⁻ wet deposition by station.

datasets.title: TAP daily gridded ozone estimates for China
datasets.description: Extracted v1 and v2 files and original ZIP archives for daily O₃. The archive preserves the source directory structure by version and year.
datasets.coverage: Nationwide. V1 covers 2014, 2017 and 2020. V2 also includes 2023.

datasets.title: Aura OMI Level 3 daily total column ozone
datasets.description: Daily global 1° grids whose file headers read OMI TO3 STD OZONE. The archive retains the original text files.
datasets.coverage: Global 1° grids in 12 annual directories between 2012 and 2025.

datasets.title: CAMx air quality station reference tables for China and regional domains
datasets.description: National, Beijing and Jining station lists with records for merging station lists or mapping stations to model grids.

datasets.title: CAMx national and Beijing station crosswalks
datasets.description: Monitoring network rosters, station crosswalks and project grid fields.

datasets.title: Global Carbon Budget and project comparison workbooks
datasets.publisher: Global Carbon Project, FireEarth and Fire_Ndep
datasets.description: The workbooks compile multiple datasets and estimates. Includes the 2024 v1.1, 2025 v0.7 and 2026 v0.1 editions, along with project comparison tables.

datasets.title: Nitrogen deposition and carbon sink reference workbook
datasets.description: Project workbook dated April 12, 2026. The chart shows model estimates of net biome production.

datasets.title: Cropland N₂O and related nitrogen flux training data
datasets.publisher: Published supplementary data compiled by the N2O_mitigation project
datasets.description: Original study supplements and project training tables for N₂O, nitrogen leaching and runoff, NH₃, and fertilizer management.

datasets.title: Global fertilizer management and ammonia volatilization supplementary data
datasets.description: Supplementary Table 3-use2775.xlsx from the original study repository.

datasets.title: WRF-GC D03 air quality observations and validation tables
datasets.description: Station O₃ and PM₂.₅ observation CSVs and matched tables containing model variables. The source time zone is unconfirmed.

datasets.title: Huai River basin operational GNSS meteorological station archive
datasets.description: Original GNSS/MET station XML archive. Use is subject to the source project's permissions.

datasets.title: Huai River basin GNSS precipitable water vapor and station data
datasets.description: Station metadata, original compressed archives and extracted high-frequency text records. Use is subject to the source project's permissions.
datasets.coverage: The project configuration uses 20 stations in the Huai River basin.

datasets.title: Huai River basin radiosonde observations at five stations
datasets.description: Radiosonde observations from Zhengzhou, Nanyang, Xuzhou, Sheyang and Fuyang. Use is subject to the source project's permissions.
datasets.coverage: Approximately October 2025 to March 2026. January 2026 is missing at Nanyang.

datasets.title: Huai River basin gridded water vapor tomography
datasets.description: Original project grids of water vapor density derived from observations. The time series contains gaps.

datasets.title: CRU TS v4.08 monthly gridded land climate data
datasets.description: Precipitation, air temperature and potential evapotranspiration data used by the project, including original downloads and extracted files.

datasets.title: JMA COBE-SST2 gridded sea surface temperature
datasets.description: Original annual GRIB2 files archived by EarthModelHub.

datasets.title: COBE-SST2 boundary data for CESM AMIP
datasets.publisher: CESM boundary data used by EarthModelHub
datasets.description: Model boundary files derived from COBE-SST2, available at 1° and 1.9° × 2.5°.

datasets.title: GFED5 historical monthly gridded burned area
datasets.description: Original release package and monthly burned area grids archived by EarthModelHub. Includes the historical reconstruction and the satellite-era product.

datasets.title: GFED5 monthly burned area for the FireEarth model
datasets.publisher: FireEarth and the Global Fire Emissions Database
datasets.description: Burned area regridded to the 2° × 2.5° FireEarth model grid, with global totals for comparison.
datasets.coverage: The file indicates 1997–2026 on a monthly 2° × 2.5° grid.

datasets.title: SRUNet VIIRS-like nighttime lights reconstruction
datasets.description: Historical nighttime lights reconstruction and simulation products, including original compressed archives and extracted files.

datasets.title: CAMx daily station observation and simulation training pairs
datasets.description: The day_sim_obs.csv and training_data_processed.csv tables contain national monitoring station observations, model output and meteorological variables.

datasets.title: BTH CAMx example and national station matchup archive
datasets.description: Includes the existing mda8_d01.csv.gz matchup table and four UTC days of example CAMx simulations. Source project file locations are listed in data/README.md.

datasets.title: Global greenhouse gas budget inversion reference data
datasets.description: Multiple versions of CO₂, CH₄ and N₂O flux inversion products, including priors, posteriors and some original releases.

datasets.title: WRF D02 hourly station meteorology validation for the CAMx study
datasets.description: Hourly temperature, relative humidity and wind speed matchups used in Supplementary Figure S6, with station metadata and validation notes. Covers 30 stations for the summers of 2014, 2017, 2020 and 2023.

datasets.title: CAMx study D01/D02 ozone station validation data
datasets.publisher: China National Environmental Monitoring Centre (CNEMC) and CAMx
datasets.description: Station observations, station lists, grid-level observations, CAMx baseline indices and audit files for the summers of 2014, 2017, 2020 and 2023. Consult the audit files when using camx_acs_ozone_grid_hourly with this archive.

datasets.title: CAMx regional project daily station O₃ and PM₂.₅ statistics
datasets.publisher: China National Environmental Monitoring Centre (CNEMC) and CAMx
datasets.description: Daily O₃ and PM₂.₅ statistics and pollution categories at 12 stations from May 1, 2024 to April 30, 2025. SHA-256 checksums agree across the Yangtze River Delta and Beijing project branches and the CAMx working copy.

datasets.title: CAMx daily station observations matched to MERRA-2
datasets.description: Daily station ozone statistics and matched MERRA-2 meteorological and surface fields for the summers of 2014, 2017, 2020 and 2023. Includes the 0.625° × 0.5° and 0.1° × 0.1° matchup tables and their training inputs.

datasets.title: 2008 MODIS leaf area index for CAMx MEGAN
datasets.description: 46 NetCDF files on a 0.05° grid contain the LAIv variable and geographic coordinates for MEGAN. Source filenames follow eight-day intervals in 2008.

datasets.title: CAMx study D01/D02 hourly gridded ozone matchups
datasets.publisher: China National Environmental Monitoring Centre (CNEMC) and CAMx
datasets.description: Two hourly gridded input tables with observed ozone, CAMx ozone and WRF meteorological fields. The audit files in camx_acs_ozone_validation record their input checksums.

datasets.title: TROPOMI tropospheric NO₂ over East Asia, processed course data
datasets.description: 119 daily tables of satellite along-track samples and two 0.5° gridded arrays for January and February 2019 and 2020, between 10–60° N and 70–150° E.

datasets.title: MOPITT gridded carbon monoxide and summary tables, course data
datasets.description: Daily 0.5° total column carbon monoxide NetCDF files for January 2021 and seven carbon monoxide summary workbooks.

datasets.title: Sentinel-5P TROPOMI Level 2 NO₂ shared archive
datasets.description: NetCDF orbital files for 2018–2026, including reprocessed and offline products.

datasets.title: GOSAT CH₄ OCPR v9 shared archive
datasets.description: Level 2 methane NetCDF files for 2009–2025, including the 2021 data used in the course.

datasets.title: Terra MOPITT Level 2 CO v9 shared archive
datasets.description: Level 2 carbon monoxide HDF-EOS5 files for 2000–2024.

datasets.title: Blended TROPOMI–GOSAT methane shared archive
datasets.description: Shared copy of the product associated with the blended_tropomi_gosat_methane repository, covering April 2018 through December 2025.

datasets.title: BTH CAMx hourly and MDA8 station ozone matchups
datasets.publisher: China National Environmental Monitoring Centre (CNEMC) and BTH-Ozone-CAMx-OSAT
datasets.description: The main sample, subsets used for Figure 2 and Figure S4, and the Beijing holdout validation. Hourly and daily tables cover D01 and D02 for the summers of 2014, 2017, 2020 and 2023. The Figure 2 D01 daily table is in camx_bth_validation.

datasets.title: OSCAR v3.1 climate and atmospheric composition benchmarks
datasets.publisher: OSCAR v3.1 and the observation product providers
datasets.description: 24 NetCDF files compiled for the project, covering greenhouse gas concentrations, surface temperature, precipitation, sea surface temperature, ocean heat content, carbon budgets, radiative forcing and related evaluation quantities.

datasets.title: NOAA GML fixed-site flask CO₂, CH₄ and N₂O
datasets.publisher: NOAA Global Monitoring Laboratory and cooperative sampling sites
datasets.description: Individual dry-air mole fraction measurements and published station monthly means. The source files include UTC sampling times, sample coordinates, flask and instrument IDs, estimated uncertainty and NOAA quality flags. The figure report compares station records with the methane seasonality study by Gang Liu, Shushi Peng and colleagues (Nature, 2025).
datasets.coverage: Global fixed-site flask network. The analysis lists the measured period and station count for each gas.

figure_report.label: Methane seasonal amplitude (Liu et al., 2025, Fig. 1) and NOAA station figures

datasets.title: NOAA GML global annual mean greenhouse gas dry-air mole fractions
datasets.description: The companion table to NOAA's Annual Greenhouse Gas Index used in the FaIR study reproduction. Includes 46 annual values from 1979–2024 and fields for 22 gases.

datasets.title: IGCC global mean surface temperature time series
datasets.publisher: Indicators of Global Climate Change and the FaIR calibration project
datasets.description: Global mean surface temperature used to calibrate FaIR, with 173 annual values from 1850–2022.

tasks.title: 2023 CNEMC Monthly Station Dataset
tasks.description: Aggregate hourly O₃ and PM₂.₅ records from China's national monitoring network by UTC month. Require valid records for at least 75% of the hours in each month and produce a station dataset for CAM and EAM.

tasks.title: June 2023 CNEMC Daily Station Dataset
tasks.description: Calculate daily maximum eight-hour mean O₃ and daily means for five other pollutants for June 1–3, 2023 using Beijing time. The dataset supports CAMx and WRF-GC.

tasks.title: 2019 Xu Daily Station O₃ Dataset
tasks.description: Extract 2019 station O₃ for China from the global archive, preserving the original date labels and daily maximum eight-hour means.

tasks.title: Rebuild Multi-Network Wet Nitrogen Deposition Workbooks
tasks.description: Clean and merge monthly wet nitrogen deposition from EANET, CAPMoN, NTN, INDAAF, and EMEP. Export individual network workbooks, the station list, and the combined workbook.

tasks.title: 2023 CAM Monthly Air Quality Validation for China
tasks.description: Pair CAM surface O₃ and PM₂.₅ with the 2023 CNEMC monthly station dataset. Use CF time bounds to assign records to months.
requires: Set MODEL_ARCHIVE to the CAM history directory.

tasks.title: CAM Monthly Wet Nitrogen Deposition Validation
tasks.description: Pair gridded model fluxes with wet deposition observations by site and month. Integrate rates over each month using the model calendar and summarize metrics by monitoring network.
requires: Set CAM_NDEP_FILE to the monthly CAM file containing NHₓ and NOᵧ wet deposition fluxes.

tasks.title: CAMx C07 D01 Hourly Grid Validation
tasks.description: Reconstruct spatial and temporal coordinates from I/O API NetCDF. Use Beijing time to aggregate hourly fields into daily maximum eight-hour mean O₃ and daily mean NO₂, SO₂, and CO, then pair them with CNEMC station observations.

tasks.title: Archived BTH CAMx Station Pairs
tasks.description: Reuse the BTH project's daily D01 O₃ station pairs for summer 2023. Apply the documented factor of 1.09375 to match reported concentrations.

tasks.title: WRF-GC Daily Air Quality Validation for China
tasks.description: Read native wrfout files and pair model output with CNEMC stations inside the model domain. Validate daily maximum eight-hour mean O₃, daily mean NO₂, and daily mean dry surface PM₂.₅.
requires: Set WRFGC_ARCHIVE to the directory of wrfout_d01 files on the same grid.
Build a CNEMC daily station dataset for the simulation period.

tasks.title: Xu 2026 Cross-Model Validation of China Wildfire Simulations
tasks.description: Use the same 2023 CNEMC monthly station dataset to validate EarthModelHub cases CESM/CAM e07 and E3SM/EAM e15 and e17. Each case's validation YAML references the case.yaml in its directory and reads the FireEarth history archive.
requires: Set EMH_CASE_DIR to each configuration directory for e07, e15, and e17 and run validation separately.

tasks.title: CAM and EAM Shared Station Sample Comparison
tasks.description: Select the sites and periods with valid model–observation pairs in all three cases, e07, e15, and e17. Recompute metrics for each model using the shared sample.
requires: Complete station validation for e07, e15, and e17.
